timeline.summary: Indiabulls Limited’s Board, led by **Mr. Gurbans Singh (Executive Chairman)** and **Mr. Divyesh Shah (Executive Director & CEO)**, will approve FY26 Q4 results on **April 29, 2026**, followed by a conference call at **4:00 PM IST**.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹408.53 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹196 Cr.
Indiabulls Limited shared the audio recording of its April 29, 2026 conference call on Q4FY26 results via its website.
Indiabulls reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹418.39 Cr and PAT of ₹194.26 Cr, marking the beginning of real estate revenue recognition.
Indiabulls Limited’s **Ram Mehar** will host a **B&K Securities Trinity 1x1 and Group Meeting** with analysts/investors on **May 28, 2026, in Mumbai (physical)**.
Indiabulls approved a ₹1,000.07 Cr preferential warrant issue to promoter and non-promoter entities.
